}

/*+@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*//*!
 \brief		wWinMain
 \date		Created  on Mon Nov 20 17:47:39 2023
 \date		Modified on Mon Nov 20 17:47:39 2023
\*//*-@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*/
int APIENTRY wWinMain(HINSTANCE hInstance, HINSTANCE hPrevInstance, WCHAR *pszCmdLine, int nCmdShow)
{
    INITCOMMONCONTROLSEX icc;
    WNDCLASSEX wcx;

    ghInstance = hInstance;

    /* Initialize common controls. Also needed for MANIFEST's */
    icc.dwSize = sizeof(icc);
    icc.dwICC = ICC_WIN95_CLASSES;
    InitCommonControlsEx(&icc);


    /* Get system dialog information */
    wcx.cbSize = sizeof(wcx);
    if (!GetClassInfoEx(NULL, MAKEINTRESOURCE(32770), &wcx))
        return 0;

    /* Add our own stuff */
    wcx.hInstance = hInstance;
    wcx.hIcon = LoadIcon(hInstance, MAKEINTRESOURCE(IDR_ICO_MAIN));
    wcx.lpszClassName = L"ToastDemClass";
    if (!RegisterClassEx(&wcx))
        return 0;

	/*
	 * Initialize COM and Windows Runtime on this thread.
	 * Make sure that the threading models of the two match.
	 */
	if (!SUCCEEDED(CoInitializeEx(NULL, COINIT_MULTITHREADED)))
		return 1;

	if (!SUCCEEDED(RoInitialize(RO_INIT_MULTITHREADED)))
		return 1;

    /* The user interface is a modal dialog box */
    return (int)DialogBox(hInstance, MAKEINTRESOURCE(DLG_MAIN), NULL, (DLGPROC)MainDlgProc);
}

/*+@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*//*!
 \brief		MainDlgProc
 \date		Created  on Mon Nov 20 17:46:26 2023
 \date		Modified on Mon Nov 20 17:46:26 2023
\*//*-@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*/
static INT_PTR CALLBACK MainDlgProc(HWND hwndDlg, UINT uMsg, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam)
{
    switch (uMsg)
    {
        case WM_INITDIALOG:
		{
			wchar_t  wszExePath[MAX_PATH + 100] = {0};
			// Obtain full path of our app.
			if (!GetExePath(wszExePath, MAX_PATH + 100, _T(TOAST_ACTIVATED_LAUNCH_ARG)))
			{
				MessageBox(hwndDlg, L"GetExePath() failure.", L"Error", MB_OK|MB_ICONERROR);
				PostQuitMessage(1);
			}
			// Register app for COM execution
			if (!fToastRegisterApp(wszExePath, APP_AUMID, L"Toast Activator Plain C Example for PellesC", L"FF00FF00", &GUID_Impl_INotificationActivationCallback))
			{
				MessageBox(hwndDlg, L"fToastRegisterApp() failure.", L"Error", MB_OK|MB_ICONERROR);
				PostQuitMessage(1);
			}
			// Register our callback function for toast notifications
			if (S_OK != fToastRegisterCallback(&h_Callback, &GUID_Impl_INotificationActivationCallback, fnNotificationCallback, (INT_PTR)GetDlgItem(hwndDlg, LV_NOTIFY)))
			{
				MessageBox(hwndDlg, L"fToastRegisterCallback() failure.", L"Error", MB_OK|MB_ICONERROR);
				PostQuitMessage(1);
			}
			// Create a toast manager to generate toast motifications
			if (!SUCCEEDED(fToastCreateNotifyManager(&hToast, APP_AUMID, &GUID_Impl_INotificationActivationCallback)))
			{
				MessageBox(hwndDlg, L"fToastCreateNotifyManager() failure.", L"Error", MB_OK|MB_ICONERROR);
				PostQuitMessage(1);
			}

			hfArial = MakeFont(_TEXT("Arial"), 11, FW_NORMAL, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, ANSI_CHARSET);
			SendMessage(GetDlgItem(hwndDlg, LV_NOTIFY), WM_SETFONT, (WPARAM)hfArial, FALSE);
			ListView_SetTextColor(GetDlgItem(hwndDlg, LV_NOTIFY), RGB(10, 10, 160));
			SetLvColumns(GetDlgItem(hwndDlg, LV_NOTIFY));
            return TRUE;
		}

        case WM_SIZE:
            return TRUE;

        case WM_COMMAND:
            switch (GET_WM_COMMAND_ID(wParam, lParam))
            {
				case BT_SEND:
				{
					WCHAR wszPath[MAX_PATH];
					GetModuleFileNameW(NULL, wszPath, MAX_PATH);
					WCHAR *p = wcsrchr(wszPath, L'\\');
					if (!p)
						p = wszPath;
					*p = L'\0';
					p = wcsrchr(wszPath, L'\\');
					if (!p)
						p = wszPath;
					*p = L'\0';
					p = wcsrchr(wszPath, L'\\');
					if (!p)
						p = wszPath;
					*p = L'\0';
					wcscpy(p, L"\\resource\\");
					WCHAR *wszTemplate = NULL;
					int sSize;
#ifdef __POCC__
					sSize = aswprintf(&wszTemplate, wszToastXaml, wszPath, wszPath);
#else
					sSize = _scwprintf(wszToastXaml, wszPath, wszPath);
#endif
					if (sSize > 0)
					{
						wszTemplate = malloc((sSize + 1) * sizeof(WCHAR));
						swprintf(wszTemplate, sSize+1, wszToastXaml, wszPath, wszPath);
						BOOL res = fToastSendNotification(hToast, wszTemplate);
						free(wszTemplate);
						if (res)
							return TRUE;
					}
					MessageBox(hwndDlg, L"fToastSendNotification() failure.", L"Error", MB_OK|MB_ICONERROR);
					PostQuitMessage(3);
					return TRUE;
				}
                case IDOK:
                    EndDialog(hwndDlg, TRUE);
                    return TRUE;
            }
            break;

        case WM_CLOSE:
			if (hfArial)
				DeleteObject(hfArial);
			if (hToast)
				fToastDeleteNotifyManager(hToast);
			if (h_Callback)
				fToastUnRegisterCallback(h_Callback);
            EndDialog(hwndDlg, 0);
            return TRUE;
    }

    return FALSE;
}

 \author	frankie
\*//*-@@file@@----------------------------------------------------------------*/
#ifdef __POCC__

#define _UNICODE
#define __STDC_WANT_LIB_EXT1__ 1

#include <notificationactivationcallback.h>

#include "include/ToastLib.h"

/*
 * The following is the memory layout used for all local objects
 * (class factory and, INotificationActivationCallback.).
 * All objects inherit from IUnknown.
 */
typedef struct InterfaceGeneric
{
	IUnknownVtbl   *lpVtbl;
	LONG64          dwRefCount;
	FN_TOAST_NOTIFY fnToastNotify;
	INT_PTR         arg;
} InterfaceGeneric;

/*+@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*//*!
 \brief		Impl_IGeneric_AddRef
 \date		Created  on Thu Nov  9 15:00:07 2023
 \date		Modified on Thu Nov  9 15:00:07 2023
\*//*-@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*/
static FORCEINLINE ULONG STDMETHODCALLTYPE Impl_IGeneric_AddRef(InterfaceGeneric *this)
{
	return (ULONG)InterlockedIncrement64(&this->dwRefCount);
}

/*+@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*//*!
 \brief		Impl_IGeneric_Release
 \date		Created  on Thu Nov  9 15:00:14 2023
 \date		Modified on Thu Nov  9 15:00:14 2023
\*//*-@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*/
static FORCEINLINE ULONG STDMETHODCALLTYPE Impl_IGeneric_Release(InterfaceGeneric *this)
{
	LONG64 dwNewRefCount = InterlockedDecrement64(&this->dwRefCount);
	if (!dwNewRefCount) free(this);
	return (ULONG)dwNewRefCount;
}

/*
 * INotificationActivationCallback implementation.
 * This implementation inherit from the INotificationActivationCallback, adding a
 * property to set the callback user function.
 */
#pragma region INotificationActivationCallback
/*
 * This is where the magic happens when someone interacts with our notification:
 * this method will be called (on another thread !!!).
 */

typedef struct
{
	INotificationActivationCallbackVtbl;
	HRESULT (STDMETHODCALLTYPE *SetUserFn)(INotificationActivationCallback *this, FN_TOAST_NOTIFY fnToastNotify);
} InterfaceNotifyVtbl;


/*+@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*//*!
 \brief		Impl_INotificationActivationCallback_QueryInterface
 \date		Created  on Thu Nov  9 14:59:55 2023
 \date		Modified on Thu Nov  9 14:59:55 2023
\*//*-@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*/
static HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE Impl_INotificationActivationCallback_QueryInterface(INotificationActivationCallback* this, REFIID riid, void **ppvObject)
{
	if (!IsEqualIID(riid, &IID_INotificationActivationCallback) && !IsEqualIID(riid, &IID_IUnknown))
	{
		*ppvObject = NULL;
		return E_NOINTERFACE;
	}
	*ppvObject = this;
	this->lpVtbl->AddRef(this);
	return S_OK;
}

/*+@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*//*!
 \brief		Impl_INotificationActivationCallback_Activate
 \date		Created  on Thu Nov  9 15:00:01 2023
 \date		Modified on Thu Nov  9 15:00:01 2023
\*//*-@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*/
static HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE Impl_INotificationActivationCallback_Activate(INotificationActivationCallback* this, LPCWSTR appUserModelId, LPCWSTR invokedArgs, const NOTIFICATION_USER_INPUT_DATA* data, ULONG count)
{
	if (((InterfaceGeneric *)this)->fnToastNotify)
	{
		((InterfaceGeneric *)this)->fnToastNotify(((InterfaceGeneric *)this)->arg, appUserModelId, invokedArgs, data, count);
		return S_OK;
	}

	return S_FALSE;
}

/*+@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*//*!
 \brief		Impl_INotificationActivationCallback_AddRef
 \date		Created  on Thu Nov  9 15:00:07 2023
 \date		Modified on Thu Nov  9 15:00:07 2023
\*//*-@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*/
static ULONG STDMETHODCALLTYPE Impl_INotificationActivationCallback_AddRef(INotificationActivationCallback *this)
{
	return Impl_IGeneric_AddRef((InterfaceGeneric *)this);
}

/*+@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*//*!
 \brief		Impl_INotificationActivationCallback_Release
 \date		Created  on Thu Nov  9 15:00:14 2023
 \date		Modified on Thu Nov  9 15:00:14 2023
\*//*-@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*/
static ULONG STDMETHODCALLTYPE Impl_INotificationActivationCallback_Release(INotificationActivationCallback *this)
{
	return Impl_IGeneric_Release((InterfaceGeneric *)this);
}

/*+@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*//*!
 \brief		Impl_INotificationActivationCallback_SetUserFn
 \date		Created  on Sun Nov 19 12:03:39 2023
 \date		Modified on Sun Nov 19 12:03:39 2023
\*//*-@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*/
static HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE Impl_INotificationActivationCallback_SetUserFn(INotificationActivationCallback *this, FN_TOAST_NOTIFY fnToastNotify)
{
	((InterfaceGeneric *)this)->fnToastNotify = fnToastNotify;
	return S_OK;
}

/*
 * Create modified Vtable for the class.
 */
static const InterfaceNotifyVtbl Impl_InterfaceNotifyVtbl =
{
	{
		.QueryInterface = Impl_INotificationActivationCallback_QueryInterface,
		.AddRef         = Impl_INotificationActivationCallback_AddRef,
		.Release        = Impl_INotificationActivationCallback_Release,
		.Activate       = Impl_INotificationActivationCallback_Activate
	},
	Impl_INotificationActivationCallback_SetUserFn
};
#pragma endregion

/*
 * IClassFactory implementation.
 */
#pragma region "IClassFactory Generic implementation"
typedef struct This_factory
{
	IClassFactoryVtbl *lpVtbl;
	LONG64             dwRefCount;
} This_factory;

/*+@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*//*!
 \brief		Impl_IClassFactory_QueryInterface
 \date		Created  on Thu Nov  9 15:00:40 2023
 \date		Modified on Thu Nov  9 15:00:40 2023
\*//*-@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*/
static HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE Impl_IClassFactory_QueryInterface(LPCLASSFACTORY this, REFIID riid, void** ppvObject)
{
	if (!IsEqualIID(riid, &IID_IClassFactory) && !IsEqualIID(riid, &IID_IUnknown))
	{
		*ppvObject = NULL;
		return E_NOINTERFACE;
	}
	*ppvObject = this;
	((This_factory *)this)->lpVtbl->AddRef(this);
	return S_OK;
}

/*+@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*//*!
 \brief		Impl_IClassFactory_LockServer
 \date		Created  on Thu Nov  9 15:00:48 2023
 \date		Modified on Thu Nov  9 15:00:48 2023
\*//*-@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*/
static HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE Impl_IClassFactory_LockServer(LPCLASSFACTORY this_, BOOL flock)
{
	return S_OK;
}

/*+@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*//*!
 \brief		Impl_IClassFactory_CreateInstance
 \date		Created  on Thu Nov  9 15:00:55 2023
 \date		Modified on Thu Nov  9 15:00:55 2023
\*//*-@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*/
static HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE Impl_IClassFactory_CreateInstance(LPCLASSFACTORY this, IUnknown *punkOuter, REFIID vTableGuid, void **ppv)
{
	*ppv = NULL;

	if (punkOuter)
	{
		return CLASS_E_NOAGGREGATION;
	}

	InterfaceGeneric *thisobj = malloc(sizeof(InterfaceGeneric));
	if (!thisobj)
		return E_OUTOFMEMORY;

	thisobj->lpVtbl        = (IUnknownVtbl *)&Impl_InterfaceNotifyVtbl;
	thisobj->dwRefCount    = 1;
	thisobj->fnToastNotify = ((InterfaceGeneric *)this)->fnToastNotify;
	thisobj->arg           = ((InterfaceGeneric *)this)->arg;
	HRESULT hr             = thisobj->lpVtbl->QueryInterface((LPUNKNOWN)thisobj, vTableGuid, ppv);
	thisobj->lpVtbl->Release((LPUNKNOWN)thisobj);

	return hr;
}

/*+@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*//*!
 \brief		Impl_IClassFactory_AddRef
 \date		Created  on Thu Nov  9 15:01:02 2023
 \date		Modified on Thu Nov  9 15:01:02 2023
\*//*-@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*/
static ULONG STDMETHODCALLTYPE Impl_IClassFactory_AddRef(LPCLASSFACTORY this)
{
	return Impl_IGeneric_AddRef((InterfaceGeneric *)this);
}

/*+@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*//*!
 \brief		Impl_IClassFactory_Release
 \date		Created  on Thu Nov  9 15:01:09 2023
 \date		Modified on Thu Nov  9 15:01:09 2023
\*//*-@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*/
static ULONG STDMETHODCALLTYPE Impl_IClassFactory_Release(LPCLASSFACTORY this)
{
	return Impl_IGeneric_Release((InterfaceGeneric *)this);
}


static const IClassFactoryVtbl Impl_IClassFactory_Vtbl =
{
	.QueryInterface = Impl_IClassFactory_QueryInterface,
	.AddRef         = Impl_IClassFactory_AddRef,
	.Release        = Impl_IClassFactory_Release,
	.LockServer     = Impl_IClassFactory_LockServer,
	.CreateInstance = Impl_IClassFactory_CreateInstance
};

typedef struct TOAST_CALLBACK
{
	LPCLASSFACTORY lpClassFactory;
	DWORD          dwRegister;
} TOAST_CALLBACK;

/*+@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*//*!
 \brief		fToastRegisterCallback
 \date		Created  on Fri Nov 17 17:53:59 2023
 \date		Modified on Fri Nov 17 17:53:59 2023
\*//*-@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*/
HRESULT WINAPI fToastRegisterCallback(H_CALLBACK *hCallback, const GUID *pGUID_INotificationActivationCallback, FN_TOAST_NOTIFY fnToastNotify, INT_PTR arg)
{
	*hCallback = calloc(1, sizeof(TOAST_CALLBACK));
	if (!*hCallback)
		return S_FALSE;

	/*
	 * Allocate class factory.
	 * This factory produces our implementation of the INotificationActivationCallback interface.
	 * This interface has an ::Activate member method that gets called when someone interacts with
	 * the toast notification.
	 */
	InterfaceGeneric *pClass  = malloc(sizeof(InterfaceGeneric));
	if (!pClass)
		return E_OUTOFMEMORY;
	pClass->lpVtbl            = (IUnknownVtbl *)&Impl_IClassFactory_Vtbl;
	pClass->dwRefCount        = 1;
	pClass->fnToastNotify     = fnToastNotify;
	pClass->arg               = arg;
	(*hCallback)->lpClassFactory = (LPCLASSFACTORY)pClass;

	/*
	 * And register the class object.
	 */
	if (!SUCCEEDED(CoRegisterClassObject(pGUID_INotificationActivationCallback,
					(LPUNKNOWN)(*hCallback)->lpClassFactory, CLSCTX_LOCAL_SERVER, REGCLS_MULTIPLEUSE, &((*hCallback)->dwRegister))))
	{
		(*hCallback)->lpClassFactory->lpVtbl->Release((*hCallback)->lpClassFactory);
		return S_FALSE;
	}

	return S_OK;
}

/*+@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*//*!
 \brief		fToastUnRegisterCallback
 \date		Created  on Sun Nov 19 23:10:57 2023
 \date		Modified on Sun Nov 19 23:10:57 2023
\*//*-@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*/
VOID WINAPI fToastUnRegisterCallback(H_CALLBACK hCallback)
{
	if (hCallback->dwRegister)
	{
		CoRevokeClassObject(hCallback->dwRegister);
	}
	if (hCallback->lpClassFactory)
	{
		hCallback->lpClassFactory->lpVtbl->Release(hCallback->lpClassFactory);
	}
	free(hCallback);
}
#pragma endregion

/*+@@file@@----------------------------------------------------------------*//*!
 \file		C_wrapper.c
 \par Description 
 \par Description 
            Toast notification library based on former work of 
            Valentin-Gabriel Radu
 \par Project: 
            ToastLib
 \date		Created  on Sun Nov 19 23:56:17 2023
 \date		Modified on Sun Nov 19 23:56:17 2023
 \author	frankie
\*//*-@@file@@----------------------------------------------------------------*/
#ifdef __POCC__
#define  UNICODE
#define _UNICODE
#define __STDC_WANT_LIB_EXT1__ 1
#endif

#include <guiddef.h>
#include <Windows.h>
#include <tchar.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <wchar.h>
#ifndef USE_WINDOWS_RUNTIME
#include "ToasterDecl.h"
#else
#include <winstring.h>
#include <roapi.h>
#include <Windows.ui.notifications.h>
#include <notificationactivationcallback.h>
#endif
#include "include/ToastLib.h"

#pragma comment(lib, "ole32.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "uuid.lib")

#define wcsbytes(x)		(((DWORD)wcslen(x) + 1)<<2)

#define TOAST_NOTIFICATION_FACTORY		__x_ABI_CWindows_CUI_CNotifications_CIToastNotificationFactory
#define TOAST_NOTIFIER					__x_ABI_CWindows_CUI_CNotifications_CIToastNotifier
typedef struct TOAST_NOTIFY
{
	WCHAR                      *wszAppId;
	TOAST_NOTIFICATION_FACTORY *pNotificationFactory;
	TOAST_NOTIFIER             *pToastNotifier;
	GUID                        GuidNotificationActivationCallback;
} TOAST_NOTIFY;

#define WSZ_GUID_BUFF_SIZE 64
/*+@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*//*!
 \brief		Guid2Wtext
 \date		Created  on Sat Nov 18 18:03:43 2023
 \date		Modified on Sat Nov 18 18:03:43 2023
\*//*-@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*/
PCWCH WINAPI Guid2Wtext(const GUID *guid, BOOL bBraces)
{
	static WCHAR wszGuid[WSZ_GUID_BUFF_SIZE];
	swprintf(wszGuid, WSZ_GUID_BUFF_SIZE, L"%ls%08X-%04X-%04X-%02X%02X-%02X%02X%02X%02X%02X%02X%ls", bBraces ? L"{" : L"",
						guid->Data1, guid->Data2, guid->Data3, guid->Data4[0], guid->Data4[1], guid->Data4[2], guid->Data4[3],
													guid->Data4[4], guid->Data4[5], guid->Data4[6], guid->Data4[7], bBraces ? L"}" : L"");
	return (PCWCH)wszGuid;
}

/*+@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*//*!
 \brief		fToastRegisterApp
 \details	The info here are used by COM manager, if the app isn't running 
            and someone interacts with the toast notification to run the 
            implementation of the interface.
            If these settings are missing, interacting with the 
            notifications will do nothing.
 \date		Created  on Sat Nov 18 16:59:37 2023
 \date		Modified on Sun Nov 19 21:37:57 2023
\*//*-@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*/
BOOL WINAPI fToastRegisterApp(WCHAR  *wszAppPath, WCHAR  *wszAppid, WCHAR  *wszDescription, WCHAR  *IconBackgroundColor, const GUID *pGUID_INotificationActivationCallback)
{
	wchar_t  wszBuf[MAX_PATH];

	/*
	 * Construct the path to the EXE that will handle requests for this interface, so COM knows
	 * that this app implements the INotificationActivationCallback interface.
	 */
	swprintf(wszBuf, MAX_PATH, L"SOFTWARE\\Classes\\CLSID\\{%ls}\\LocalServer32", Guid2Wtext(pGUID_INotificationActivationCallback, FALSE));
	if (RegSetValueW(HKEY_CURRENT_USER, wszBuf, REG_SZ, wszAppPath, wcsbytes(wszAppPath)) != ERROR_SUCCESS)
		return FALSE;

	/*
	 * Associate our AUMID (Application User Model ID) with the app GUID above (the one that is associated with class factory
	 * which produces our INotificationActivationCallback interface) and set some properties.
	 */
	swprintf(wszBuf, MAX_PATH, L"SOFTWARE\\Classes\\AppUserModelId\\%ls", wszAppid);
	if (RegSetKeyValueW(HKEY_CURRENT_USER, wszBuf, L"DisplayName", REG_SZ, wszDescription, wcsbytes(wszDescription)) != ERROR_SUCCESS)
		return FALSE;

	if (RegSetKeyValueW(HKEY_CURRENT_USER, wszBuf, L"IconBackgroundColor", REG_SZ, IconBackgroundColor, wcsbytes(IconBackgroundColor)) != ERROR_SUCCESS)
		return FALSE;

	PCWCH wszGuid = Guid2Wtext(pGUID_INotificationActivationCallback, TRUE);
	if (RegSetKeyValueW(HKEY_CURRENT_USER, wszBuf, L"CustomActivator", REG_SZ, wszGuid, wcsbytes(wszGuid)) != ERROR_SUCCESS)
		return FALSE;

	return TRUE;
}

/*+@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*//*!
 \brief		GetNotificationFactory
 \date		Created  on Sat Nov 18 22:37:34 2023
 \date		Modified on Sat Nov 18 22:37:34 2023
\*//*-@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*/
static HRESULT GetNotificationFactory(H_TOAST hToast)
{
	HRESULT  hr;

	hToast->pToastNotifier       = NULL;
	hToast->pNotificationFactory = NULL;

	/*
	 * Obtain a runtime Toast manager handle.
	 */
	HSTRING_HEADER hshToastNotificationManager;
	HSTRING        hsToastNotificationManager = NULL;
	__x_ABI_CWindows_CUI_CNotifications_CIToastNotificationManagerStatics *pToastNotificationManager = NULL;
	if (!SUCCEEDED(WindowsCreateStringReference(RuntimeClass_Windows_UI_Notifications_ToastNotificationManager,
							(UINT32)wcslen(RuntimeClass_Windows_UI_Notifications_ToastNotificationManager),
											&hshToastNotificationManager, &hsToastNotificationManager)))
		return S_FALSE;
	hr = RoGetActivationFactory(hsToastNotificationManager, &IID_IToastNotificationManagerStatics, (LPVOID*)&pToastNotificationManager);
	WindowsDeleteString(hsToastNotificationManager);
	if (!SUCCEEDED(hr))
		return S_FALSE;

	/*
	 * Creates and initializes a new instance of the ToastNotification bound to a specified app.
	 */
	HSTRING_HEADER hshAppId;
	HSTRING        hsAppId = NULL;
	if (!SUCCEEDED(WindowsCreateStringReference(hToast->wszAppId, (DWORD)wcslen(hToast->wszAppId), &hshAppId, &hsAppId)))
		return S_FALSE;
	hr = pToastNotificationManager->lpVtbl->CreateToastNotifierWithId(pToastNotificationManager, hsAppId, &hToast->pToastNotifier);
	WindowsDeleteString(hsAppId);
	pToastNotificationManager->lpVtbl->Release(pToastNotificationManager);
	if (!SUCCEEDED(hr))
		return S_FALSE;

	/*
	 * Obtain a runtime toast notification handler
	 */
	HSTRING_HEADER hshToastNotification;
	HSTRING        hsToastNotification = NULL;
	if (!SUCCEEDED(WindowsCreateStringReference(RuntimeClass_Windows_UI_Notifications_ToastNotification,
								(UINT32)wcslen(RuntimeClass_Windows_UI_Notifications_ToastNotification),
																			&hshToastNotification, &hsToastNotification)))
		return S_FALSE;
	hr = RoGetActivationFactory(hsToastNotification, &IID_IToastNotificationFactory, (LPVOID*)&hToast->pNotificationFactory);
	WindowsDeleteString(hsToastNotification);
	if (!SUCCEEDED(hr))
		return S_FALSE;

	return S_OK;
}

/*+@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*//*!
 \brief		fToastDeleteNotifyManager
 \date		Created  on Sat Nov 18 23:47:43 2023
 \date		Modified on Sat Nov 18 23:47:43 2023
\*//*-@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*/
VOID WINAPI fToastDeleteNotifyManager(H_TOAST hToast)
{
	if (hToast->pNotificationFactory)
		hToast->pNotificationFactory->lpVtbl->Release(hToast->pNotificationFactory);
	if (hToast->pToastNotifier)
		hToast->pToastNotifier->lpVtbl->Release(hToast->pToastNotifier);

	if (hToast->wszAppId)
		free(hToast->wszAppId);

	free(hToast);
}

/*+@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*//*!
 \brief		fToastCreateNotifyManager
 \date		Created  on Sat Nov 18 23:16:48 2023
 \date		Modified on Sat Nov 18 23:16:48 2023
\*//*-@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*/
HRESULT WINAPI fToastCreateNotifyManager(H_TOAST *hToastNotify, WCHAR *app_id, const GUID *GuidNotificationActivationCallback)
{
	*hToastNotify = NULL;
	H_TOAST hToast = calloc(1, sizeof(TOAST_NOTIFY));
	if (!hToast)
		return E_OUTOFMEMORY;
	hToast->wszAppId = _wcsdup(app_id);
	if (!hToast->wszAppId)
	{
		free(hToast);
		return E_OUTOFMEMORY;
	}
	hToast->GuidNotificationActivationCallback = *GuidNotificationActivationCallback;
	HRESULT hr = GetNotificationFactory(hToast);
	if (!SUCCEEDED(hr))
	{
		fToastDeleteNotifyManager(hToast);
		return hr;
	}

	*hToastNotify = hToast;
	return S_OK;
}

/*+@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*//*!
 \brief		fToastSendNotification
 \date		Created  on Sat Nov 18 16:47:00 2023
 \date		Modified on Sat Nov 18 16:47:00 2023
\*//*-@@fnc@@----------------------------------------------------------------*/
BOOL WINAPI fToastSendNotification(H_TOAST hToast, LPCWSTR wszTemplate)
{
	HRESULT  hr;

	/*
	 * Activates an XML Windows Runtime class.
	 */
	HSTRING_HEADER hshXmlDocument;
	HSTRING        hsXmlDocument = NULL;
	IInspectable  *pInspectable  = NULL;
	if (!SUCCEEDED(WindowsCreateStringReference(RuntimeClass_Windows_Data_Xml_Dom_XmlDocument,
					(UINT32)wcslen(RuntimeClass_Windows_Data_Xml_Dom_XmlDocument), &hshXmlDocument, &hsXmlDocument)))
		return FALSE;
	hr = RoActivateInstance(hsXmlDocument, &pInspectable);
	WindowsDeleteString(hsXmlDocument);
	if (!SUCCEEDED(hr))
		return FALSE;
	/*
	 * Instanziate IXmlDocument class
	 */
	__x_ABI_CWindows_CData_CXml_CDom_CIXmlDocument *pXmlDocument = NULL;
	if (!SUCCEEDED(pInspectable->lpVtbl->QueryInterface(pInspectable, &IID_IXmlDocument, (void **)&pXmlDocument)))
		return FALSE;
	pInspectable->lpVtbl->Release(pInspectable);
	/*
	 * Instanziate IXmlDocumentIO class
	 */
	__x_ABI_CWindows_CData_CXml_CDom_CIXmlDocumentIO *pXmlDocumentIO = NULL;
	if (!SUCCEEDED(pXmlDocument->lpVtbl->QueryInterface(pXmlDocument, &IID_IXmlDocumentIO, (void **)&pXmlDocumentIO)))
		return FALSE;

	HSTRING_HEADER hshBanner;
	HSTRING        hsBanner = NULL;
	if (!SUCCEEDED(WindowsCreateStringReference(wszTemplate, (UINT32)wcslen(wszTemplate), &hshBanner, &hsBanner)))

	hr = pXmlDocumentIO->lpVtbl->LoadXml(pXmlDocumentIO, hsBanner);
	WindowsDeleteString(hsBanner);
	pXmlDocumentIO->lpVtbl->Release(pXmlDocumentIO);
	if (!SUCCEEDED(hr))
		return FALSE;

	__x_ABI_CWindows_CUI_CNotifications_CIToastNotification *pToastNotification = NULL;
	if (!SUCCEEDED(hToast->pNotificationFactory->lpVtbl->CreateToastNotification(hToast->pNotificationFactory, pXmlDocument, &pToastNotification)))
		return FALSE;
	pXmlDocument->lpVtbl->Release(pXmlDocument);

	if (!SUCCEEDED(hToast->pToastNotifier->lpVtbl->Show(hToast->pToastNotifier, pToastNotification)))
		return FALSE;
	pToastNotification->lpVtbl->Release(pToastNotification);

	return TRUE;
}

Public Function FIO_PTH(GF1 As GF_) As GF_
    Dim GF As GF_
        GF = GF1
            GF.WF = CHK_FD(GF.WF)
            GF.WF = CHK_DIR(GF.WF, GF1.WF.url.NXT.OPRWX)
                If GF.WF.url.NXT.NXTFIO Then
                  GF = FIO(GF)
                End If
        FIO_PTH = GF
End Function



Public Function FIO(GF1 As GF_) As GF_
    Dim GF As GF_
        GF = GF1
            GF.WF = CHK_FF(GF.WF)
           GF = FIO_(GF)
        FIO = GF
End Function

Public Function OFIO(GF1 As GF_, OPRWX As Byte) As GF_
    Dim GF As GF_
        GF = GF1
            If OPRWX = RWO_WO Then
                GF.WF = OF_OUT(GF.WF)
                    If GF.WF.url.FI.BOOL.oB Then
                        GF.WF = WF_OUT(GF.WF)
                        If GF.WF.url.FI.BOOL.wB Then
                            GF.WF.url.NXT.SVR_DTA = "Saved "
                            Else
                             GF.WF.url.NXT.SVR_DTA = "Error "
                        End If
                        FI_DTA GF.WF
                    End If
                Else
                    GF.WF = OF_IN(GF.WF)
                    GF.WF = RF_IN(GF.WF)
                        If GF.WF.url.FI.BOOL.rB Then
                            GF.WF.url.NXT.SVR_DTA = "Read "
                            Else
                             GF.WF.url.NXT.SVR_DTA = "Error "
                        End If
                       FI_DTA GF.WF
            End If
    GF.WF.url.FI.BOOL.oB = OF_CLS(GF.WF.FD.iFN)
    OFIO = GF
End Function

Public Function FIO_(GF1 As GF_) As GF_
    Dim GF As GF_
        GF = GF1
            Select Case GF.GUI.gOPT.BTN.CLK
                Case True
                    Select Case GF.GUI.CMI.cIDX.IDX
                        Case 1
                             Select Case GF.GUI.gOPT.mOPT.GSO = 1
                                Case True ' no asmbl
                                    GF = OFIO(GF, GF.WF.url.NXT.OPRWX)
                              End Select
                        Case 2 'open edit
                                Select Case GF.GUI.gOPT.mOPT.GSO
                                Case 1 ' no asmbl
                                  '  Enable_EDIT_NEW GF
                                End Select
                        Case 3  'delete
                            Select Case GF.GUI.gOPT.mOPT.GSO = 2
                                Case True ' no asmbl
                                    If GF.WF.url.FI.BOOL.fB Then
                                        If MsgBox(GF.WF.url.FI.FNME, vbYesNo, "Delete " & GF.GUI.XV.FV.FO.bOPT(GF.GUI.gOPT.bOPT.GSO) & "?") = vbYes Then
                                               ' If GF.WF.DL.vbDir.vbDE Then
                                              '      KILL_D GF.WF.url.FIOD
                                              '  Else
                                                    KILL_F GF.WF.url.FPF
                                              '  End If
                                           ' GF = FIX_SEL(GF, GF.GUI.XV.FV.fixSEL.fsKILL)
                                        End If
                                    Else
                                        MSG_ "File not found::" & GF.WF.url.FI.FFN
                                    End If
                            End Select
                    End Select
                Case False
                GF = OFIO(GF, GF.WF.url.NXT.OPRWX)
            End Select
    FIO_ = GF
End Function

Attribute VB_Name = "Module1"
'Attribute VB_Name = "Module1"
Option Explicit
 
'Console Application Sample
'Written by Nir Sofer.
'
'Web site: http://nirsoft.mirrorz.com
'
'In order to create a console application from this code, follow the instructions below:
'1. Make an executable file from this project.
'2. Run the "Application Mode Changer" utility and change the mode of the
'executable file to "Console Application".
 
Public Declare Function GetStdHandle Lib "kernel32" _
(ByVal nStdHandle As Long) As Long
 
Private Declare Function WriteFile Lib "kernel32" _
(ByVal hFile As Long, _
lpBuffer As Any, _
ByVal nNumberOfBytesToWrite As Long, _
lpNumberOfBytesWritten As Long, _
lpOverlapped As Any) As Long
 
Public Const STD_OUTPUT_HANDLE = -11&
 
Private Type COORD
        x As Integer
        y As Integer
End Type
 
Private Type SMALL_RECT
        Left As Integer
        Top As Integer
        Right As Integer
        Bottom As Integer
End Type
 
Private Type CONSOLE_SCREEN_BUFFER_INFO
        dwSize As COORD
        dwCursorPosition As COORD
        wAttributes As Integer
        srWindow As SMALL_RECT
        dwMaximumWindowSize As COORD
End Type
Private Declare Function GetConsoleScreenBufferInfo Lib "kernel32" _
(ByVal hConsoleOutput As Long, _
lpConsoleScreenBufferInfo As CONSOLE_SCREEN_BUFFER_INFO) As Long
 
Private Declare Function SetConsoleTextAttribute Lib "kernel32" _
(ByVal hConsoleOutput As Long, ByVal wAttributes As Long) As Long
 
Private Const FOREGROUND_BLUE = &H1     '  text color contains blue.
Private Const FOREGROUND_GREEN = &H2     '  text color contains green.
Private Const FOREGROUND_INTENSITY = &H8     '  text color is intensified.
Private Const FOREGROUND_RED = &H4     '  text color contains red.
 
Private hOutput             As Long
 
'The following function writes the content of sText variable into the console window:
Private Function WriteToConsole(sText As String) As Boolean
    Dim lWritten            As Long
    
    If WriteFile(hOutput, ByVal sText, Len(sText), lWritten, ByVal 0) = 0 Then
        WriteToConsole = False
    Else
        WriteToConsole = True
    End If
End Function
 
Public Sub Main()
    Dim scrbuf      As CONSOLE_SCREEN_BUFFER_INFO
    
    'Get the standard output handle
    hOutput = GetStdHandle(STD_OUTPUT_HANDLE)
    GetConsoleScreenBufferInfo hOutput, scrbuf
    WriteToConsole "Console Application Example In Visual Basic." & vbCrLf
    WriteToConsole "Written by Nir Sofer" & vbCrLf
    WriteToConsole "Web site: http://nirsoft.mirrorz.com" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf
    
    'Change the text color to blue
    SetConsoleTextAttribute hOutput, FOREGROUND_BLUE Or FOREGROUND_INTENSITY
    WriteToConsole "Blue Color !!" & vbCrLf
    
    'Change the text color to yellow
    SetConsoleTextAttribute hOutput, FOREGROUND_RED Or FOREGROUND_GREEN Or FOREGROUND_INTENSITY
    WriteToConsole "Yellow Color !!" & vbCrLf
    
    'Restore the previous text attributes.
    SetConsoleTextAttribute hOutput, scrbuf.wAttributes
    If Len(Command$) <> 0 Then
        'Show the command line parameters:
        WriteToConsole vbCrLf & "Command Line Parameters: " & Command$ & vbCrLf
    End If
End Sub

Public Function RF_GF(DRV As String, CDR As String, FN As String, CLIDTA As String, SVRDTA As String) As GF_

RWO = True

    Public Sub NOTFY(MCDE As Long, DLM_ As String, STAT As String, Optional CST As String = "NOINFO")
     Select Case MCDE
     Case 0: Form1.Label1 = ERR & DLM_ & STAT & DLM_
     Case 1: Form1.Label1 = RDY_ & DLM_ & STAT & DLM_
      Case Else: Form1.Label1 = "CUSTM" & DLM_ & STAT & DLM_ & CST
      
     End Select
    End Sub
Public Sub GCW()
If AllocConsole() Then
    NOTFY 1, DLM1, "AllocConsole"
    Dim BWRT As Long
    HCON.INPUT = GetStdHandle(STD_INPUT_HANDLE)
    HCON.ERROR = GetStdHandle(STD_ERROR_HANDLE)
    HCON.OUTPUT = GetStdHandle(STD_OUTPUT_HANDLE)
   ' SetConsoleMode HCON.INPUT, ENABLE_ECHO_INPUT
Else
    NOTFY 0, DLM1, "AllocConsole"
End If

End Sub
Public Sub Main()
Form1.Show

      
    End Sub
    
    
Public Sub ExecuteCommand(sCommand As String)
    Shell "cmd.exe /c " & sCommand, vbHide ' /c closes the window after execution
End Sub


Public Sub WCSNDCMD(CMDSTR As String)
    WCW CMDSTR
    ExecuteCommand CMDSTR
End Sub
    Public Function RCW(Optional COBJ As Long) As String
    
    'SetConsoleMode HCON, ENABLE_ECHO_INPUT
    
    Dim BTXT  As String * 256
    Dim BLEN  As Long
    Dim TXT  As String
    TXT = String(256, Chr(32))
    
    ReadConsole HCON.INPUT, BTXT, Len(BTXT), vbNull, vbNull
   NOTFY 2, DLM1, "ReadConsole:" & BLEN, Time
  
    RCW = Left$(TXT, BLEN)
End Function

Public Function WCW(SIOI As String, Optional COBJ As Long)
    

    
    Dim TXT As String * 256
   TXT = SIOI & vbCrLf
    
    
    WriteConsole HCON.OUTPUT, TXT, Len(TXT), BWRT, vbNull
   NOTFY 2, DLM1, "WriteConsole: " & BWRT, Time
    WCW = BWRT
End Function

Option Explicit
Private Function GetStringTable(mode As String) As String

End Function
Public Function ReadINIKey(keyName As String) As String
    Dim ini As String
    Dim f As Integer
    Dim line As String

    ini = App.path & "\darkstar.ini"

    ' If INI file doesn�t exist, return empty
    If Dir$(ini) = "" Then
        ReadINIKey = ""
        Exit Function
    End If

    f = FreeFile
    On Error GoTo IniErr
    Open ini For Input As #f
    Do While Not EOF(f)
        Line Input #f, line
        If InStr(1, line, keyName & "=", vbTextCompare) > 0 Then
            ReadINIKey = Trim$(Mid$(line, InStr(line, "=") + 1))
            Close #f
            Exit Function
        End If
    Loop
    Close #f
    Exit Function

IniErr:
    On Error Resume Next
    Close #f
    ReadINIKey = ""
End Function
Public Sub WriteINIKey(keyName As String, value As String)
    Dim ini As String
    Dim f As Integer
    Dim line As String
    Dim lines As Collection
    Dim found As Boolean

    ini = App.path & "\darkstar.ini"
    Set lines = New Collection

    ' Read existing lines
    If Dir$(ini) <> "" Then
        f = FreeFile
        Open ini For Input As #f
        Do While Not EOF(f)
            Line Input #f, line
            If InStr(1, line, keyName & "=", vbTextCompare) > 0 Then
                lines.Add keyName & "=" & value
                found = True
            Else
                lines.Add line
            End If
        Loop
        Close #f
    End If

    ' If key not found, append it
    If Not found Then
        lines.Add keyName & "=" & value
    End If

    ' Rewrite the file
    f = FreeFile
    Open ini For Output As #f
    For Each line In lines
        Print #f, line
    Next line
    Close #f
End Sub
Public Sub GenerateRES(mode As String)
    On Error GoTo RES_Err

    Dim f As Integer
    Dim rcPath As String
    Dim sh As Object

    rcPath = App.path & "\batch.rc"

    f = FreeFile
    Open rcPath For Output As #f
    Print #f, GetStringTable(mode)
    Close #f

    Set sh = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
    sh.CurrentDirectory = App.path
    sh.Run "rc.exe batch.rc", 1, True

    Exit Sub

RES_Err:
    MsgBox "? RES generation failed: " & Err.Number & " - " & Err.Description, vbCritical
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub
Public Function FolderExists(path As String) As Boolean
    On Error GoTo ErrHandler
    If Len(Dir$(path, vbDirectory)) = 0 Then
        FolderExists = False
    Else
        ' Check attribute to ensure it's a directory
        FolderExists = (GetAttr(path) And vbDirectory) = vbDirectory
    End If
    Exit Function
ErrHandler:
    FolderExists = False
End Function
Public Function ReadAllLines(path As String) As Collection
    Dim c As New Collection
    Dim f As Integer
    Dim s As String

    f = FreeFile
    Open path For Input As #f

    Do Until EOF(f)
        Line Input #f, s
        c.Add s
    Loop

    Close #f

    Set ReadAllLines = c
End Function

Public Function ReadTextFile(path As String) As String
    Dim f As Integer
    Dim s As String

    f = FreeFile
    Open path For Input As #f
    s = Input$(LOF(f), f)
    Close #f

    ReadTextFile = s
End Function
Public Function ExtractAfterEquals(s As Variant) As String
    Dim p As Long
    p = InStr(s, "=")
    If p > 0 Then
        ExtractAfterEquals = Mid$(s, p + 1)
    Else
        ExtractAfterEquals = ""
    End If
End Function
Public Function SafeReadFile(path As String) As String
    Dim f As Integer
    Dim s As String

    If Dir$(path) = "" Then
        SafeReadFile = "(File not found: " & path & ")" & vbCrLf
        Exit Function
    End If

    f = FreeFile
    Open path For Input As #f
    s = Input$(LOF(f), f)
    Close #f

    SafeReadFile = s
End Function

Public Sub ParseVBPModuleLine(ByVal line As String, ByRef modName As String, ByRef fileName As String)
    Dim p As Long
    Dim raw As String
    Dim parts() As String

    modName = ""
    fileName = ""

    p = InStr(line, "=")
    If p = 0 Then Exit Sub

    raw = Mid$(line, p + 1)
    parts = Split(raw, ";")

    If UBound(parts) >= 0 Then modName = Trim$(parts(0))
    If UBound(parts) >= 1 Then fileName = Trim$(parts(1))
End Sub

Public Sub SaveSection(src As String, marker As String, outFile As String)
    Dim f As Integer
    Dim lines() As String
    Dim i As Long, startLine As Long, endLine As Long
    Dim section As String

    lines = Split(src, vbCrLf)
    startLine = -1: endLine = -1

    ' Find section start
    For i = 0 To UBound(lines)
        If Trim$(lines(i)) = marker Then
            startLine = i + 1
        ElseIf startLine <> -1 And Left$(Trim$(lines(i)), 2) = "##" Then
            endLine = i - 1
            Exit For
        End If
    Next i

    If startLine = -1 Then Exit Sub
    If endLine = -1 Then endLine = UBound(lines)

    ' Collect section text
    For i = startLine To endLine
        section = section & lines(i) & vbCrLf
    Next i

    ' Write out to file
    f = FreeFile
    Open outFile For Output As #f
    Print #f, section
    Close #f
End Sub

Private Function GetClipboardText() As String
    Dim DataObj As Object
    Set DataObj = CreateObject("MSForms.DataObject")
    On Error Resume Next
    DataObj.GetFromClipboard
    GetClipboardText = DataObj.GetText
End Function

Public Function GetFileText(path As String) As String
    Dim f As Integer
    Dim line As String
    Dim content As String

    If Dir$(path) = "" Then
        GetFileText = "(File not found: " & path & ")"
        Exit Function
    End If

    f = FreeFile
    Open path For Input As #f
    Do While Not EOF(f)
        Line Input #f, line
        content = content & line & vbCrLf
    Loop
    Close #f

    GetFileText = content
End Function

' ================================
'   LOGGING
' ================================
Public Sub BatchLog(msg As String)
    Dim f As Integer
    Dim logPath As String

    logPath = App.path & "\batch_log.txt"
    f = FreeFile

    On Error Resume Next
    Open logPath For Append As #f
    Print #f, Format$(Now, "yyyy-mm-dd hh:nn:ss") & "  " & msg
    Close #f
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' ================================
'   INI WRITER
' ================================
Public Sub BatchWriteINI(section As String, key As String, value As String)
    Dim f As Integer
    Dim ini As String

    ini = App.path & "\" & BATCH_INI
    f = FreeFile

    On Error Resume Next
    Open ini For Append As #f
    Print #f, "[" & section & "] " & key & "=" & value
    Close #f
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' ================================
'   SIMPLE EXECUTOR
' ================================
Public Sub RunBatchFile(batchPath As String)
    Dim sh As Object
    Dim fullCmd As String

    If Len(Dir$(batchPath)) = 0 Then
        BatchLog "? ERROR: Batch file not found ? " & batchPath
        Exit Sub
    End If

    fullCmd = """" & batchPath & """"
    Set sh = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
    BatchLog "? Executing batch: " & fullCmd
    sh.Run fullCmd, 1, True
    BatchLog "? Batch completed."
End Sub

VERSION 1.0 CLASS
BEGIN
  MultiUse = -1
END
Attribute VB_Name = "BatchEngine"
Option Explicit

Private mBatchFile As String, mWorkingDir As String, mLogFile As String, mLastError As String

Public Property Let BatchFile(path As String): mBatchFile = path: End Property
Public Property Get BatchFile() As String: BatchFile = mBatchFile: End Property
Public Property Let WorkingDir(path As String): mWorkingDir = path: End Property
Public Property Get WorkingDir() As String: WorkingDir = mWorkingDir: End Property
Public Property Let LogFile(path As String): mLogFile = path: End Property
Public Property Get LogFile() As String: LogFile = mLogFile: End Property
Public Property Get LastError() As String: LastError = mLastError: End Property

Public Sub Execute()
    Dim sh As Object, fullPath As String, fullCmd As String
    On Error GoTo ExecErr
    fullPath = mWorkingDir: If Right$(fullPath, 1) <> "\" Then fullPath = fullPath & "\"
    fullPath = fullPath & mBatchFile
    If Len(Dir$(fullPath)) = 0 Then mLastError = "Batch file not found: " & fullPath: Exit Sub
    fullCmd = """" & fullPath & """"
    Set sh = CreateObject("WScript.Shell"): sh.CurrentDirectory = mWorkingDir
    sh.Run fullCmd, 1, True
    Exit Sub
ExecErr:
    mLastError = "ERROR: " & Err.Number & " - " & Err.Description
End Sub

@echo off
setlocal enableextensions

rem ? ? ? Cloud Engine build ritual
set ROOT=%~dp0
set PPJ=%~1

if "%PPJ%"=="" (
  echo Usage: build.bat "D:\path\to\cloud.ppj"
  exit /b 1
)

echo Building Cloud Engine: %PPJ%
echo Root: %ROOT%

rem Paths (adjust if needed)
set PELLESC_BIN=C:\PellesC\bin
set OUT=%ROOT%output

if not exist "%OUT%" mkdir "%OUT%"

rem Compile units
"%PELLESC_BIN%\pocc.exe" -c -DWIN32 -I"%ROOT%include" -Fo"%OUT%\cloud.obj" "%ROOT%src\cloud.c"
"%PELLESC_BIN%\pocc.exe" -c -DWIN32 -I"%ROOT%include" -Fo"%OUT%\cwin_procs.obj" "%ROOT%src\cwin_procs.c"
"%PELLESC_BIN%\pocc.exe" -c -DWIN32 -I"%ROOT%include" -Fo"%OUT%\dev_monitor.obj" "%ROOT%src\dev_monitor.c"
"%PELLESC_BIN%\pocc.exe" -c -DWIN32 -I"%ROOT%include" -Fo"%OUT%\master.obj" "%ROOT%src\master.c"
"%PELLESC_BIN%\pocc.exe" -c -DWIN32 -I"%ROOT%include" -Fo"%OUT%\menu.obj" "%ROOT%src\menu.c"

if errorlevel 1 (
  echo Build failed during compile.
  exit /b 2
)

rem Link
"%PELLESC_BIN%\polink.exe" /subsystem:windows /out:"%OUT%\cloud.exe" ^
  "%OUT%\cloud.obj" "%OUT%\cwin_procs.obj" "%OUT%\dev_monitor.obj" "%OUT%\master.obj" "%OUT%\menu.obj"

if errorlevel 1 (
  echo Build failed during link.
  exit /b 3
)

echo Build success: "%OUT%\cloud.exe"
endlocal

Attribute VB_Name = "Darkstar"

Option Explicit

' ================================
'   PATH NORMALIZATION
' ================================
Public Function Path_Normalize(ByVal path As String) As String
    If Len(path) = 0 Then
        Path_Normalize = ""
        Exit Function
    End If

    path = Trim$(Replace$(path, """", ""))

    Do While InStr(path, "\\") > 0
        path = Replace$(path, "\\", "\")
    Loop

    If Right$(path, 1) <> "\" Then
        path = path & "\"
    End If

    Path_Normalize = path
End Function

' ================================
'   SAFE DIR (TOP OF FILES LINE)
' ================================
Public Function SafeDir(ByVal path As String, ByVal attr As Long) As String
    Dim result As String
    On Error Resume Next

    result = Dir$(path, attr)

    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        result = ""
        Err.Clear
    End If

    SafeDir = result
End Function

' ================================
'   SAFE GETATTR
' ================================
Public Function SafeGetAttr(ByVal path As String) As Long
    Dim a As Long
    On Error Resume Next

    a = GetAttr(path)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        a = -1
        Err.Clear
    End If

    SafeGetAttr = a
End Function

' ================================
'   EXISTS: FOLDER
' ================================
Public Function Exists_Folder(ByVal path As String) As Boolean
    Dim a As Long
    Dim d As String

    path = Path_Normalize(path)

    d = SafeDir(path, vbDirectory)
    If d = "" Then
        Exists_Folder = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    a = SafeGetAttr(path)
    Exists_Folder = (a <> -1) And ((a And vbDirectory) = vbDirectory)
End Function

' ================================
'   EXISTS: FILE
' ================================
Public Function Exists_File(ByVal path As String) As Boolean
    Dim a As Long

    If Dir$(path) = "" Then
        Exists_File = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    a = SafeGetAttr(path)
    Exists_File = (a <> -1) And ((a And vbDirectory) = 0)
End Function

' ================================
'   LIST FILES
' ================================
Public Function ListFiles(ByVal folder As String, ByVal pattern As String) As Collection
    Dim c As New Collection
    Dim f As String

    folder = Path_Normalize(folder)

    If Not Exists_Folder(folder) Then
        Set ListFiles = c
        Exit Function
    End If

    f = SafeDir(folder & pattern, vbNormal Or vbHidden Or vbSystem Or vbReadOnly)

    Do While f <> ""
        c.Add f
        f = Dir$
    Loop

    Set ListFiles = c
End Function

' ================================
'   PATH JOIN
' ================================
Public Function Path_Join(ByVal folder As String, ByVal file As String) As String
    folder = Path_Normalize(folder)
    Path_Join = folder & file
End Function

' ================================
'   SAFE SHELL
' ================================
Public Sub SafeShell(ByVal folder As String, ByVal cmd As String)
    Dim sh As Object

    folder = Path_Normalize(folder)

    If Not Exists_Folder(folder) Then Exit Sub

    Set sh = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
    sh.CurrentDirectory = folder
    sh.Run cmd, 1, False
End Sub

' ================================
'   LOAD VB PROJECT
' ================================
Public Sub LoadVBProject(ByVal folder As String)
    Dim files As Collection
    Dim vbp As String
    Dim fullPath As String

    folder = Path_Normalize(folder)

    If Not Exists_Folder(folder) Then Exit Sub

    Set files = ListFiles(folder, "*.vbp")
    If files.Count = 0 Then Exit Sub

    vbp = files.item(1)
    fullPath = Path_Join(folder, vbp)

    SafeShell folder, "VB6.EXE """ & fullPath & """"
End Sub

- size: 2065
```
Attribute VB_Name = "DarkstarFS"

Option Explicit

' ============================================================
'   DARKSTAR FILESYSTEM MODULE
'   Safe path handling, directory validation, attribute buffers
' ============================================================

' ------------------------------
' Normalize folder path
' ------------------------------
Public Function DS_NormalizeFolder(path As String) As String
    DS_NormalizeFolder = Darkstar.Path_Normalize(path)
End Function



' ------------------------------
' Normalize file path
' ------------------------------
Public Function DS_NormalizeFile(path As String) As String
    If Len(path) = 0 Then
        DS_NormalizeFile = ""
        Exit Function
    End If

    ' Remove quotes and trim
    path = Trim$(Replace$(path, """", ""))

    DS_NormalizeFile = path
End Function

' ------------------------------
' Safe path joiner
' ------------------------------
Public Function DS_PathJoin(folder As String, file As String) As String
    DS_PathJoin = Darkstar.Path_Join(folder, file)
End Function


' ------------------------------
' True folder validator
' ------------------------------
Public Function DS_FolderExists(path As String) As Boolean
    DS_FolderExists = Darkstar.Exists_Folder(path)
End Function



' ================================
'   DARKSTAR FILESYSTEM MODULE
' ================================

Public Function DS_ListFiles(folder As String, pattern As String) As Collection
    Set DS_ListFiles = Darkstar.ListFiles(folder, pattern)
End Function



' ------------------------------
' True file validator
' ------------------------------
Public Function DS_FileExists(path As String) As Boolean
    On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    Dim attrs As Long

    If Len(Dir$(path)) = 0 Then
        DS_FileExists = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    attrs = GetAttr(path)

    DS_FileExists = ((attrs And vbDirectory) = 0)
    Exit Function

ErrHandler:
    DS_FileExists = False
End Function

```

      Width           =   2000
   End
End
Attribute VB_Name = "FormMain"
Option Explicit

Private Sub cmdRebuildProject_Click()
    Dim clipText As String
    clipText = Clipboard.GetText()

    If InStr(clipText, "# Project Source Dump") = 0 Then
        MsgBox "Clipboard does not contain a valid project scroll.", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If

    SaveSection clipText, "## Batch.bas", App.Path & "\Batch.bas"
    SaveSection clipText, "## Batch.cls", App.Path & "\Batch.cls"
    SaveSection clipText, "## FormMain.frm", App.Path & "\FormMain.frm"

    LoadVBProject "D:\VBGOD_LD\StarshipDetector"

    MsgBox "? Darkstar project files rebuilt and VB6 project refreshed.", vbInformation
End Sub

Attribute VB_Name = "frmProjectSelect"
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = False
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False


Option Explicit

Private mFolder As String

Public Sub LoadProjects(projList As Collection, folder As String)
    Dim item As Variant
    mFolder = folder
    lstProjects.Clear

    For Each item In projList
        lstProjects.AddItem item
    Next item

    ' Auto-open if only one project exists
    If lstProjects.ListCount = 1 Then
        lstProjects.ListIndex = 0
        OpenSelectedProject
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub cmdOpen_Click()
    OpenSelectedProject
End Sub

Private Sub lstProjects_DblClick()
    OpenSelectedProject
End Sub

Private Sub OpenSelectedProject()
    Dim choice As String

    If lstProjects.ListIndex = -1 Then
        MsgBox "? Please select a project.", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If

    choice = lstProjects.List(lstProjects.ListIndex)

    SafeShell "vb6.exe " & Chr$(34) & mFolder & choice & Chr$(34), _
              False, App.path & "\batch_log.txt"

    Debug.Print "? Darkstar opened project: " & mFolder & choice

    Unload Me
End Sub

Attribute VB_Name = "modConfig"

Option Explicit

Public Const DARKSTAR_INI As String = "darkstar.ini"

' Global, if you want to cache them
Public gBasePath As String
Public gPellesPath As String

' ================================
'   Simple INI writer (append-only)
' ================================
Public Sub WriteINI(section As String, key As String, value As String)
    Dim f As Integer
    Dim ini As String

    ini = App.path & "\darkstar.ini"
    f = FreeFile

    On Error Resume Next
    Open ini For Append As #f
    Print #f, "[" & section & "] " & key & "=" & value
    Close #f
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' ================================
'   FirstRun flag (persistent by INI)
' ================================

Public Sub SetFirstRunFlag(isFirstRun As Boolean)
    Dim val As String
    val = IIf(isFirstRun, "1", "0")
    WriteINI "Flags", "FirstRun", val
End Sub

' ================================
'   Store base paths in INI
' ================================
Public Sub InitBasePaths()
    Dim baseFirst As String
    Dim baseUpdated As String

    ' Your canonical roots
    baseFirst = "D:\VBGOD_LD\StarshipDetector\"
    baseUpdated = "D:\projects\vb6\VBGOD_LDR\"

    WriteINI "Paths", "FirstRunBase", baseFirst
    WriteINI "Paths", "UpdatedRunBase", baseUpdated
End Sub

' ================================
'   Low-level: read a key from INI
'   (very simple linear scan)
' ================================
Private Function ReadINIKey(keyName As String) As String
    Dim ini As String
    Dim f As Integer
    Dim line As String

    ini = App.path & "\" & DARKSTAR_INI

    If Dir$(ini) = "" Then Exit Function

    f = FreeFile
    On Error GoTo IniErr
    Open ini For Input As #f
    Do While Not EOF(f)
        Line Input #f, line
        If InStr(1, line, keyName & "=", vbTextCompare) > 0 Then
            ReadINIKey = Trim$(Mid$(line, InStr(line, "=") + 1))
            Close #f
            Exit Function
        End If
    Loop
    Close #f
    Exit Function

IniErr:
    On Error Resume Next
    Close #f
End Function

' ================================
'   Load base path using FirstRun logic
' ================================
Public Function LoadBasePath() As String
    Dim baseUpdated As String
    Dim baseFirst As String

    baseUpdated = ReadINIKey("UpdatedRunBase")
    baseFirst = ReadINIKey("FirstRunBase")

    If FirstRun() Then
        If baseFirst <> "" Then
            LoadBasePath = baseFirst
        Else
            LoadBasePath = App.path & "\"
        End If
    Else
        If baseUpdated <> "" Then
            LoadBasePath = baseUpdated
        ElseIf baseFirst <> "" Then
            LoadBasePath = baseFirst
        Else
            LoadBasePath = App.path & "\"
        End If
    End If

    ' Normalize
    If Right$(LoadBasePath, 1) <> "\" Then
        LoadBasePath = LoadBasePath & "\"
    End If
End Function

' ================================
'   Derive PellesC_engine path
' ================================
Public Function LoadPellesPath() As String
    Dim base As String
    base = LoadBasePath()
    LoadPellesPath = base & "PellesC_engine\"
End Function

Attribute VB_Name = "modExtra"

Option Explicit
Option Base 0

Private Const INI_FILE As String = "first_run.ini"

' ===== First Run Check =====
Public Function IsFirstRun() As Boolean
    Dim iniPath As String
    iniPath = App.path & "\" & INI_FILE
    
    If Dir$(iniPath) = "" Then
        IsFirstRun = True
    Else
        IsFirstRun = False
    End If
End Function

' ===== Drop INI File =====
' ===== DropFirstRunINI =====
Public Sub DropFirstRunINI()
    Dim iniPath As String
    iniPath = App.path & "\first_run.ini"
    Dim fnum As Integer
    fnum = FreeFile
    Open iniPath For Output As #fnum
        Print #fnum, "[StarshipDetector]"
        Print #fnum, "AppPath=" & App.path
        Print #fnum, "ProjectDir=" & App.path & "\Projects"   ' <-- new line
        Print #fnum, "FirstRun=1"
        Print #fnum, "RollbackFlag=0"
    Close #fnum
End Sub
Public Sub LogChecksum(path As String)
    On Error Resume Next
    Dim hash As String
    hash = SHA256_File(path)
    If Err.Number = 0 Then
        WriteLog "Checksum: " & path & " ? " & hash
    Else
        WriteLog "Checksum ERROR: " & path & " (" & Err.Description & ")"
        Err.Clear
    End If
End Sub


Public Sub VerifyFileChecksum(path As String, expectedHash As String)
    Dim actualHash As String
    
    actualHash = SHA256_File(path)
    
    If LCase$(actualHash) = LCase$(expectedHash) Then
        WriteLog "Checksum OK: " & path
    Else
        WriteLog "Checksum MISMATCH: " & path & vbCrLf & _
                 "Expected: " & expectedHash & vbCrLf & _
                 "Actual:   " & actualHash
        VBGOD_LDR_FRM.lblStatus.Caption = "Checksum mismatch detected!"
    End If
End Sub

Public Function SHA256_File(path As String) As String
    Dim stream As Object
    Dim crypto As Object
    
    Set stream = CreateObject("ADODB.Stream")
    stream.Type = 1 ' binary
    stream.Open
    stream.LoadFromFile path
    
    Set crypto = CreateObject("System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256Managed")
    SHA256_File = BytesToHex(crypto.ComputeHash_2(stream.Read))
    
    stream.Close
End Function
Public Function SafeLoadFromFile(path As String) As String
    Dim fso As Object, ts As Object
    
    Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
    
    If fso.FileExists(path) Then
        Set ts = fso.OpenTextFile(path, 1)
        SafeLoadFromFile = ts.ReadAll
        ts.Close
        WriteLog "? File loaded successfully: " & path
    Else
        SafeLoadFromFile = "(? Error: File not found ? " & path & ")"
        WriteLog "? Drift Detected: File cannot be opened ? " & path
    End If
End Function


Private Function BytesToHex(bytes As Variant) As String
    Dim i As Long
    Dim hexStr As String
    
    For i = 1 To LenB(bytes)
        hexStr = hexStr & Right$("0" & Hex(AscB(MidB(bytes, i, 1))), 2)
    Next
    
    BytesToHex = hexStr
End Function

Public Function GetIniValue(ByVal key As String) As String
    Dim iniPath As String, fnum As Integer, line As String
    iniPath = App.path & "\first_run.ini"
    GetIniValue = ""
    
    If Dir$(iniPath) = "" Then Exit Function
    
    fnum = FreeFile
    Open iniPath For Input As #fnum
        Do While Not EOF(fnum)
            Line Input #fnum, line
            If InStr(1, line, key & "=", vbTextCompare) = 1 Then
                GetIniValue = Mid$(line, Len(key) + 2)
                Exit Do
            End If
        Loop
    Close #fnum
End Function

' ===== ReadAllText =====

Public Function ReadAllText(ByVal FilePath As String) As String
    Dim fnum As Integer, content As String
    fnum = FreeFile
    Open FilePath For Input As #fnum
        content = Input$(LOF(fnum), fnum)
    Close #fnum
    ReadAllText = content
End Function


' ===== WriteAllText =====

Public Sub WriteAllText(ByVal FilePath As String, ByVal content As String)
    Dim fnum As Integer
    fnum = FreeFile
    Open FilePath For Output As #fnum
        Print #fnum, content
    Close #fnum
End Sub

' ===== FileExists =====
Public Function FileExists(ByVal path As String) As Boolean
    FileExists = (Len(Dir$(path)) > 0)
End Function

' ===== DeleteFile =====
Public Sub DeleteFile(ByVal FilePath As String)
    If FileExists(FilePath) Then
        Kill FilePath
        WriteLog "Deleted file: " & FilePath
    End If
End Sub





' ===== AppendText =====
Public Sub AppendText(ByVal FilePath As String, ByVal content As String)
    Dim fnum As Integer
    fnum = FreeFile
    Open FilePath For Append As #fnum
        Print #fnum, content
    Close #fnum
End Sub

' ===== Verify First Run EXE =====
Public Sub VerifyFirstRunExe()
    Dim exePath As String
    exePath = App.path & "\firstrun.exe"
    
    If FileExists(exePath) Then
        SafeShell exePath
        WriteLog "First run exe launched for verification."
    Else
        WriteLog "First run exe missing."
    End If
End Sub

' ===== Flag Rollback =====
Public Sub FlagRollback()
    Dim fnum As Integer
    Dim iniPath As String
    iniPath = App.path & "\" & INI_FILE
    
    fnum = FreeFile
    Open iniPath For Append As #fnum
        Print #fnum, "RollbackFlag=1"
    Close #fnum
    
    WriteLog "Rollback flag set in INI."
End Sub
' ===== Utility Routines =====

Option Explicit

Public Type DarkstarGF
    folder As String
    command As String
    logFile As String

Public Sub WriteLog(msg As String)
    Dim f As Integer
    Dim logPath As String

    logPath = App.path & "\starship_log.txt"
    f = FreeFile

    On Error Resume Next
    Open logPath For Append As #f
    Print #f, Format$(Now, "yyyy-mm-dd hh:nn:ss") & "  " & msg
    Close #f
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' ================================
'   GF constructor
'   Folder is ALWAYS derived from LoadPellesPath()
' ================================
Public Function GF(command As String, logFile As String) As DarkstarGF
    Dim g As DarkstarGF

    g.folder = LoadPellesPath()
    g.command = command
    g.logFile = logFile

    GF = g
End Function

Attribute VB_Name = "modStarship"

Option Explicit
Option Base 0
Public Sub Project_RunSelected(lst As ListBox)
    If lst.ListIndex < 0 Then Exit Sub

    Dim sel As String
    sel = lst.List(lst.ListIndex)

    ' VB6 project (local path)
    If LCase$(Right$(sel, 4)) = ".vbp" Then
        WriteLog "Launching VB6 project: " & sel
        Shell """C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\VB98\VB6.EXE"" """ & App.path & "\" & sel & """", vbNormalFocus
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' Tagged PellesC entries ("C:filename")
    If Left$(sel, 2) = "C:" Then
         CloudEngine_Run sel
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' Fallback: batch scripts in App.Path
    If LCase$(Right$(sel, 4)) = ".bat" Then
        WriteLog "Launching batch: " & sel
        Shell "cmd.exe /c """ & App.path & "\" & sel & """", vbNormalFocus
    End If
End Sub
Public Sub VerifyFileChecksum(path As String, expectedHash As String)
    Dim actualHash As String
    
    actualHash = SHA256_File(path)
    
    If LCase$(actualHash) = LCase$(expectedHash) Then
        WriteLog "Checksum OK: " & path
    Else
        WriteLog "? Drift Detected ? " & path & vbCrLf & _
                 "Expected: " & expectedHash & vbCrLf & _
                 "Actual:   " & actualHash
        
        ' Update status banner
        VBGOD_LDR_FRM.lblStatus.Caption = "? Drift Detected ?"
        
        ' Append drift alert to diagnostic scroll
        Dim files As New Collection
        files.Add path
        WriteDiagnosticBanner "? Drift Detected ?", files
    End If
End Sub
Public Sub RunPPJDownlinkCombined()
    Dim rootC As String
    Dim ppjPath As String
    Dim exePath As String
    Dim files As New Collection
    Dim outcome As String
    
    rootC = "D:\projects\vb6\VBGOD_LDR\PellesC_engine\"
    ppjPath = rootC & "cloud.ppj"
    exePath = rootC & "output\cloud.exe"
    
    WriteLog "? ? ? Downlink: shelling PPJ ? " & ppjPath
    
    ' Always shell the PPJ build script
    SafeShell rootC, "build_cloud_ppj.bat", "build_log.txt"
    
    ' Add header + build script to file list
    files.Add "cloud.ppj"
    files.Add "build_cloud_ppj.bat"
    files.Add "build_log.txt"
    
    ' Decide outcome based on exe presence
    If Dir$(exePath) <> "" Then
        WriteLog "? ? ? Downlink: running cloud.exe"
        SafeShell rootC & "output\", "cloud.exe", "cloud_run_log.txt"
        
        files.Add "cloud.exe"
        files.Add "cloud_run_log.txt"
        
        outcome = "PPJ Shell Run: OK"
        VBGOD_LDR_FRM.lblStatus.Caption = "PPJ shell run complete."
    Else
        outcome = "PPJ Shell Run: Errors (header archived)"
        VBGOD_LDR_FRM.lblStatus.Caption = "PPJ shell run (errors acceptable)."
    End If
    
    ' Archive diagnostic banner
    WriteDiagnosticBanner outcome, files
End Sub
Public Sub RunPPJDownlinkDriftAware()
    Dim rootC As String
    Dim ppjPath As String

    rootC = "D:\projects\vb6\VBGOD_LDR\PellesC_engine\"

        Else
            outcome = "PPJ Shell Run: Errors (header archived)"
        End If
    End If
    
    ' Archive diagnostic banner

End Sub
Public Sub WriteCrownScroll(ppjPath As String, exePath As String, filesChecked As Collection, driftAlerts As Collection)
    Dim fso As Object
    Dim logFile As Object
    Dim path As String
    Dim entry As String
    Dim f As Variant
    Dim alert As Variant
    
    path = App.path & "\convoy_integrity_log.md"
    Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
    
    ' Open or create the log file
    If fso.FileExists(path) Then
        Set logFile = fso.OpenTextFile(path, 8) ' append
    Else
        Set logFile = fso.CreateTextFile(path, True)
    End If
    
    ' Build Markdown entry
    entry = vbCrLf & "# ? ? ?" & vbCrLf
    entry = entry & "# PPJ Downlink Crown Scroll � " & Format$(Now, "yyyy-mm-dd hh:nn:ss") & vbCrLf & vbCrLf
    
    entry = entry & "## Header" & vbCrLf
    entry = entry & "- " & ppjPath & vbCrLf
    entry = entry & "- build_cloud_ppj.bat" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf
    
    entry = entry & "## Build Log" & vbCrLf & "```" & vbCrLf
    entry = entry & ReadFile(App.path & "\build_log.txt") & vbCrLf & "```" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf
    
    entry = entry & "## Run Log" & vbCrLf & "```" & vbCrLf
    If fso.FileExists(App.path & "\cloud_run_log.txt") Then
        entry = entry & ReadFile(App.path & "\cloud_run_log.txt") & vbCrLf
    Else
        entry = entry & "(No run log available)" & vbCrLf
    End If
    entry = entry & "```" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf
    
    entry = entry & "## Files Checked" & vbCrLf
    For Each f In filesChecked
        entry = entry & "- " & f & vbCrLf
    Next
    entry = entry & vbCrLf
    
    entry = entry & "## Outcome" & vbCrLf
    If VBGOD_LDR_FRM.lblStatus.Caption = "? Drift Detected ?" Then
        entry = entry & "- ? Drift Detected ?" & vbCrLf
    ElseIf Dir$(exePath) <> "" Then
        entry = entry & "- PPJ Shell Run: OK" & vbCrLf
    Else
        entry = entry & "- PPJ Shell Run: Errors (header archived)" & vbCrLf
    End If
    entry = entry & vbCrLf
    
    entry = entry & "## Drift Alerts" & vbCrLf
    If driftAlerts.Count > 0 Then
        For Each alert In driftAlerts
            entry = entry & "- " & alert & vbCrLf
        Next
    Else
        entry = entry & "- None" & vbCrLf
    End If
    
    ' Write entry
    logFile.WriteLine entry
    logFile.Close
    
    WriteLog "Crown scroll inscribed."
End Sub


Public Sub CheckCrownSchedule()
    Dim currentDay As Integer
    Dim currentHour As Integer
    Dim currentMinute As Integer
    
    currentDay = Weekday(Now, vbSunday)   ' Sunday = 1
    currentHour = Hour(Now)
    currentMinute = Minute(Now)
    
    If currentDay = 1 And currentHour = 17 And currentMinute = 0 Then
        WriteLog "? ? ? Crown Scroll ritual invoked automatically."
        
        ' Prepare file list
        Dim files As New Collection
        files.Add "cloud.ppj"
        files.Add "build_cloud_ppj.bat"
        files.Add "build_log.txt"
        files.Add "cloud.exe"
        files.Add "cloud_run_log.txt"
        
        ' Collect drift alerts
        Dim driftAlerts As Collection
        Set driftAlerts = CollectDriftAlerts()
        
        ' Run PPJ downlink
        RunPPJDownlinkDriftAware
        
        ' Write crown scroll with drift alerts
        WriteCrownScroll "cloud.ppj", "output\cloud.exe", files, driftAlerts
    End If
End Sub


Public Function CollectDriftAlerts() As Collection
    Dim driftAlerts As New Collection
    Dim fso As Object
    Dim ts As Object
    Dim line As String
    
    Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
    
    ' Parse the checksum log for drift events
    If fso.FileExists(App.path & "\checksum_log.txt") Then
        Set ts = fso.OpenTextFile(App.path & "\checksum_log.txt", 1)
        Do Until ts.AtEndOfStream
            line = ts.ReadLine
            If InStr(line, "? Drift Detected ?") > 0 Then
                driftAlerts.Add line
            End If
        Loop
        ts.Close
    End If
    
    Set CollectDriftAlerts = driftAlerts
End Function


Public Function ReadFile(path As String) As String
    Dim fso As Object, ts As Object
    Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
    If fso.FileExists(path) Then
        Set ts = fso.OpenTextFile(path, 1)
        ReadFile = ts.ReadAll
        ts.Close
    Else
        ReadFile = "(File not found: " & path & ")"
    End If
End Function

Public Sub WriteHeaderOnlyBanner(ppjPath As String)
    Dim fso As Object
    Dim logFile As Object
    Dim path As String
    Dim entry As String
    
    path = App.path & "\convoy_integrity_log.md"
    Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
    
    ' Open or create the log file
    If fso.FileExists(path) Then
        Set logFile = fso.OpenTextFile(path, 8) ' append
    Else
        Set logFile = fso.CreateTextFile(path, True)
    End If
    
    ' Build Markdown entry
    entry = vbCrLf & "# ? ? ?" & vbCrLf
    entry = entry & "# PPJ Shell Attempt � " & Format$(Now, "yyyy-mm-dd hh:nn:ss") & vbCrLf & vbCrLf
    entry = entry & "## Header Archived" & vbCrLf
    entry = entry & "- " & ppjPath & vbCrLf & vbCrLf
    entry = entry & "## Outcome" & vbCrLf
    entry = entry & "- PPJ shelled, errors acceptable (header archived)" & vbCrLf
    
    ' Write entry
    logFile.WriteLine entry
    logFile.Close
    
    WriteLog "Header-only diagnostic banner written for " & ppjPath
End Sub


' ===== Checksum Manifest Routine =====
Public Sub COSMIC_SCAN_ChecksumManifest()
    Dim fso As Object
    Dim folder As Object
    Dim File As Object
    Dim rootVB6 As String
    Dim rootC As String
    
    rootVB6 = App.path & "\"
    rootC = "D:\projects\vb6\VBGOD_LDR\PellesC_engine\"
    Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
    
    ' VB6 artifacts
    WriteLog "=== VB6 Convoy Checksum ==="
    Call LogChecksum(rootVB6 & "VBGOD_LDR_FRM.frm")
    Call LogChecksum(rootVB6 & "VBGOD_LDR.bas")
    Call LogChecksum(rootVB6 & "modStarship.bas")
    Call LogChecksum(rootVB6 & "modExtra.bas")
    Call LogChecksum(rootVB6 & "project_code_Block_names.md")
    Call LogChecksum(rootVB6 & "first_run.ini")
    Call LogChecksum(rootVB6 & "build_windows.bat")
    Call LogChecksum(rootVB6 & "verify_starship.bat")
    
    ' PellesC sources
    WriteLog "=== PellesC Sources (.c) ==="
    Set folder = fso.GetFolder(rootC & "src")
    For Each File In folder.files
        If LCase(fso.GetExtensionName(File.Name)) = "c" Then
            Call LogChecksum(File.path)
        End If
    Next
    
    ' PellesC headers
    WriteLog "=== PellesC Headers (.h) ==="
    Set folder = fso.GetFolder(rootC & "include")
    For Each File In folder.files
        If LCase(fso.GetExtensionName(File.Name)) = "h" Then
            Call LogChecksum(File.path)
        End If
    Next
    
    ' PellesC artifacts
    WriteLog "=== PellesC Artifacts (.exe/.obj/.ppj) ==="
    Set folder = fso.GetFolder(rootC & "output")
    For Each File In folder.files
        If LCase(fso.GetExtensionName(File.Name)) = "exe" Or _
           LCase(fso.GetExtensionName(File.Name)) = "obj" Then
            Call LogChecksum(File.path)
        End If
    Next
    
    Call LogChecksum(rootC & "cloud.ppj")
    Call LogChecksum(rootC & "cloud.ppx")
    Call LogChecksum(rootC & "cloud.tag")
    Call LogChecksum(rootC & "manifest.json")
    Call LogChecksum(rootC & "README.md")
    
    VBGOD_LDR_FRM.lblStatus.Caption = "Extended checksum manifest complete."

End Sub

Public Sub WriteDiagnosticBanner(outcome As String, filesChecked As Collection)
    Dim fso As Object
    Dim logFile As Object
    Dim path As String
    Dim entry As String
    Dim f As Variant
    
    path = App.path & "\convoy_integrity_log.md"
    Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
    
    ' Open or create the log file
    If fso.FileExists(path) Then
        Set logFile = fso.OpenTextFile(path, 8) ' append
    Else
        Set logFile = fso.CreateTextFile(path, True)
    End If
    
    ' Build Markdown entry
    entry = vbCrLf & "# ? ? ?" & vbCrLf
    entry = entry & "# Convoy Integrity Run � " & Format$(Now, "yyyy-mm-dd hh:nn:ss") & vbCrLf & vbCrLf
    
    entry = entry & "## Files Checked" & vbCrLf
    For Each f In filesChecked
        entry = entry & "- " & f & vbCrLf
    Next
    
    entry = entry & vbCrLf & "## Outcome" & vbCrLf
    entry = entry & "- " & outcome & vbCrLf
    
    ' Write entry
    logFile.WriteLine entry
    logFile.Close
    
    WriteLog "Diagnostic banner written with full file list."
End Sub

Public Sub CheckSchedule()
    Dim currentDay As Integer
    Dim currentHour As Integer
    Dim currentMinute As Integer
    
    ' Get current time
    currentDay = Weekday(Now, vbSunday)   ' Sunday = 1
    currentHour = Hour(Now)
    currentMinute = Minute(Now)
    
    ' Covenant time: Sunday 5:00 PM EST
    If currentDay = 1 And currentHour = 17 And currentMinute = 0 Then
        WriteLog "? ? ? Crown Scroll ritual invoked automatically."
        
        ' Prepare file list
        Dim files As New Collection
        files.Add "cloud.ppj"
        files.Add "build_cloud_ppj.bat"
        files.Add "build_log.txt"
        files.Add "cloud.exe"
        files.Add "cloud_run_log.txt"
        
        ' Collect drift alerts
        Dim driftAlerts As Collection
        Set driftAlerts = CollectDriftAlerts()
        
        ' Shell the PPJ build script
        SafeShell App.path & "\PellesC_engine\", "build_cloud_ppj.bat", "build_log.txt"
        
        ' Run exe if present
        If Dir$(App.path & "\PellesC_engine\output\cloud.exe") <> "" Then
            SafeShell App.path & "\PellesC_engine\output\", "cloud.exe", "cloud_run_log.txt"
            VBGOD_LDR_FRM.lblStatus.Caption = "PPJ shell run complete."
        Else
            VBGOD_LDR_FRM.lblStatus.Caption = "PPJ shell run (errors acceptable)."
        End If
        
        ' Write crown scroll
        WriteCrownScroll "cloud.ppj", "output\cloud.exe", files, driftAlerts
    End If
End Sub

Public Sub CloudEngine_Run(token As String)
    Dim nameOnly As String
    Dim rootC As String
    rootC = "D:\projects\vb6\VBGOD_LDR\PellesC_engine\"

    nameOnly = Mid$(token, 3) ' strip "C:"

    Select Case LCase$(Right$(nameOnly, 4))
        Case ".ppj"
            WriteLog "CloudEngine: build invoked for " & nameOnly
            Shell "cmd.exe /c """ & rootC & "build.bat"" """ & rootC & nameOnly & """", vbNormalFocus

' ===== Checksum Expansion =====
Public Function SHA256Checksum(ByVal FilePath As String) As String
    Dim result As String
    Dim tempFile As String
    tempFile = Environ$("TEMP") & "\sha256.txt"
    Shell "cmd /c certutil -hashfile """ & FilePath & """ SHA256 > """ & tempFile & """", vbHide
    result = ReadAllText(tempFile)
    Dim lines() As String, i As Integer
    lines = Split(result, vbCrLf)
    For i = LBound(lines) To UBound(lines)
        If Len(Trim(lines(i))) > 0 And InStr(lines(i), "SHA256") = 0 Then
            SHA256Checksum = Trim(lines(i))
            Exit Function
        End If
    Next i
End Function

' ===== Checksum Logging =====
Public Sub LogChecksumsInDirectory(ByVal folderPath As String)
    Dim f As String
    f = Dir$(folderPath & "\*.*")
    Do While Len(f) > 0
        WriteLog "Checksum for " & f & ": " & SHA256Checksum(folderPath & "\" & f)
        f = Dir$
    Loop
End Sub

Public Function ReadINIKey(keyName As String) As String
    Dim ini As String
    Dim f As Integer
    Dim line As String

    ini = App.path & "\darkstar.ini"

    ' If INI file doesn�t exist, return empty
    If Dir$(ini) = "" Then
        ReadINIKey = ""
        Exit Function
    End If

    f = FreeFile
    On Error GoTo IniErr
    Open ini For Input As #f
    Do While Not EOF(f)
        Line Input #f, line
        If InStr(1, line, keyName & "=", vbTextCompare) > 0 Then
            ReadINIKey = Trim$(Mid$(line, InStr(line, "=") + 1))
            Close #f
            Exit Function
        End If
    Loop
    Close #f
    Exit Function

IniErr:
    On Error Resume Next
    Close #f
    ReadINIKey = ""
End Function
Public Sub WriteINIKey(keyName As String, value As String)
    Dim ini As String
    Dim f As Integer
    Dim line As String
    Dim lines As Collection
    Dim found As Boolean

    ini = App.path & "\darkstar.ini"
    Set lines = New Collection

    ' Read existing lines
    If Dir$(ini) <> "" Then
        f = FreeFile
        Open ini For Input As #f
        Do While Not EOF(f)
            Line Input #f, line
            If InStr(1, line, keyName & "=", vbTextCompare) > 0 Then
                lines.Add keyName & "=" & value
                found = True
            Else
                lines.Add line
            End If
        Loop
        Close #f
    End If

    ' If key not found, append it
    If Not found Then
        lines.Add keyName & "=" & value
    End If

    ' Rewrite the file
    f = FreeFile
    Open ini For Output As #f
    For Each line In lines
        Print #f, line
    Next line
    Close #f
End Sub

Public Sub ParseVBPModuleLine(ByVal line As String, ByRef modName As String, ByRef fileName As String)
    Dim p As Long
    Dim raw As String
    Dim parts() As String

    modName = ""
    fileName = ""

    p = InStr(line, "=")
    If p = 0 Then Exit Sub

    raw = Mid$(line, p + 1)
    parts = Split(raw, ";")

    If UBound(parts) >= 0 Then modName = Trim$(parts(0))
    If UBound(parts) >= 1 Then fileName = Trim$(parts(1))
End Sub

Public Sub SaveSection(src As String, marker As String, outFile As String)
    Dim f As Integer
    Dim lines() As String
    Dim i As Long, startLine As Long, endLine As Long
    Dim section As String

    lines = Split(src, vbCrLf)
    startLine = -1: endLine = -1

    ' Find section start
    For i = 0 To UBound(lines)
        If Trim$(lines(i)) = marker Then
            startLine = i + 1
        ElseIf startLine <> -1 And Left$(Trim$(lines(i)), 2) = "##" Then
            endLine = i - 1
            Exit For
        End If
    Next i

    If startLine = -1 Then Exit Sub
    If endLine = -1 Then endLine = UBound(lines)

    ' Collect section text
    For i = startLine To endLine
        section = section & lines(i) & vbCrLf
    Next i

    ' Write out to file
    f = FreeFile
    Open outFile For Output As #f
    Print #f, section
    Close #f
End Sub

Option Explicit

Private mBatchFile As String, mWorkingDir As String, mLogFile As String, mLastError As String

Public Property Get BatchFile() As String: BatchFile = mBatchFile: End Property
Public Property Let WorkingDir(path As String): mWorkingDir = path: End Property
Public Property Get WorkingDir() As String: WorkingDir = mWorkingDir: End Property
Public Property Let LogFile(path As String): mLogFile = path: End Property

Public Property Get LastError() As String: LastError = mLastError: End Property

Public Sub Execute()
    Dim sh As Object, fullPath As String, fullCmd As String
    On Error GoTo ExecErr
    fullPath = mWorkingDir: If Right$(fullPath, 1) <> "\" Then fullPath = fullPath & "\"
    fullPath = fullPath & mBatchFile
    If Len(Dir$(fullPath)) = 0 Then mLastError = "Batch file not found: " & fullPath: Exit Sub
    fullCmd = """" & fullPath & """"
    Set sh = CreateObject("WScript.Shell"): sh.CurrentDirectory = mWorkingDir
    sh.Run fullCmd, 1, True
    Exit Sub
ExecErr:
    mLastError = "ERROR: " & Err.Number & " - " & Err.Description
End Sub
