Attribute VB_Name = "SafeShellMod"

Option Explicit

' Uses:
'   DarkstarGF      (from modGF)
'   WriteLog        (from modGF)
'   WriteINI        (from modConfig)
'   LoadPellesPath  (from modConfig)
Public Sub SafeShell(folder As String, command As String, LogFile As String)
    Dim sh As Object
    Dim fullPath As String
    Dim fullCmd As String

    On Error GoTo ShellErr

    ' Build full path to command
    fullPath = folder
    If Right$(fullPath, 1) <> "\" Then fullPath = fullPath & "\"
    fullPath = fullPath & command

    ' Log & INI trace
    WriteLog "? SafeShell invoked"
    WriteLog "  Folder:  " & folder
    WriteLog "  Command: " & command
    WriteLog "  FullPath:" & fullPath

    WriteINI "SafeShell", "Folder", folder
    WriteINI "SafeShell", "Command", command
    WriteINI "SafeShell", "FullPath", fullPath

    ' Validate folder
    folder = DS_NormalizeFolder(folder)

    If Not DS_FolderExists(folder) Then
        WriteLog "? ERROR: Folder does not exist ? " & folder
        WriteINI "SafeShell", "Error", "Folder does not exist: " & folder
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' Validate command file
    If Len(Dir$(fullPath)) = 0 Then
        WriteLog "? ERROR: Command missing ? " & fullPath
        WriteINI "SafeShell", "Error", "Command missing: " & fullPath
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Set sh = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
    WriteINI "SafeShell", "CurrentDirectoryBefore", sh.CurrentDirectory

    sh.CurrentDirectory = folder
    WriteINI "SafeShell", "CurrentDirectoryAfter", sh.CurrentDirectory

    fullCmd = """" & fullPath & """"
    WriteINI "SafeShell", "Executed", fullCmd

    sh.Run fullCmd, 0, True

    WriteLog "? SafeShell completed successfully."
    Exit Sub

ShellErr:
    WriteLog "? ERROR in SafeShell: " & Err.Number & " - " & Err.Description
    WriteINI "SafeShell", "Error", Err.Description
End Sub


Public Sub SafeShellGF(g As DarkstarGF)
    SafeShell g.folder, g.command, g.LogFile
End Sub
Public Function FirstRun() As Boolean
    Dim ini As String
    Dim f As Integer
    Dim line As String
    Dim found As Boolean

    ini = App.path & "\darkstar.ini"

    ' No INI at all ? first run
    If Dir$(ini) = "" Then
        FirstRun = True

        ' Create INI with correct first-run and updated-run base paths
        f = FreeFile
        Open ini For Output As #f
        Print #f, "[Flags] FirstRun=1"
        Print #f, "[Paths] FirstRunBase=D:\VBGOD_LD\StarshipDetector\"
        Print #f, "[Paths] UpdatedRunBase=D:\projects\vb6\VBGOD_LDR\"
        Close #f

        Exit Function
    End If

    ' INI exists ? read FirstRun flag
    f = FreeFile
    Open ini For Input As #f
    Do While Not EOF(f)
        Line Input #f, line
        If InStr(1, line, "FirstRun=", vbTextCompare) > 0 Then
            found = True
            FirstRun = (Trim$(Mid$(line, InStr(line, "=") + 1)) = "1")
            Exit Do
        End If
    Loop
    Close #f

    ' If no FirstRun key found, default to True
    If Not found Then FirstRun = True
End Function

Attribute VB_Name = "VBGOD_LDR_FRM"

Option Explicit

Private mFolder As String

Public Sub LoadProjects(projList As Collection, folder As String)
    Dim item As Variant
    mFolder = folder
    lstProjects.Clear
    For Each item In projList
        lstProjects.AddItem item
    Next item
End Sub

Private Sub cmdOpen_Click()
    OpenSelectedProject
End Sub


Private Sub lstProjects_DblClick()
    OpenSelectedProject
End Sub

Private Sub OpenSelectedProject()
    Dim choice As String
    If lstProjects.ListIndex = -1 Then
        MsgBox "? Please select a project.", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If
    choice = lstProjects.List(lstProjects.ListIndex)
    SafeShell "vb6.exe " & Chr$(34) & mFolder & choice & Chr$(34), False, App.path & "\batch_log.txt"
    Unload Me
End Sub

Private Sub cmdPPJBuild_Click()
    Dim pelleFolder As String
    Dim LogFile As String

    pelleFolder = GFPath(App.path, "PellesC_engine")
    LogFile = "build_log.txt"

    lblPPJStatus.Caption = "PPJ shell running..."
    lblCrownStatus.Caption = "Crown Scroll pending..."
    lblPPJStatus.Refresh
    lblCrownStatus.Refresh
Dim g As DarkstarGF

g = GF(pelleFolder, "build_cloud_ppj.bat", LogFile)

SafeShellGF g

    

    ' After SafeShell returns, check for cloud.exe via GFRun context
    Dim ctx As GFRunContext
    GF_InitRunContext ctx

    If GF_CanRunCloud(ctx) Then
        lblPPJStatus.Caption = "PPJ shell run complete."
        lblCrownStatus.Caption = "Crown Scroll inscribed."
        WriteLog "? PPJ shell run complete � cloud.exe present."
    Else
        lblPPJStatus.Caption = "PPJ shell run failed � exe missing."
        lblCrownStatus.Caption = "Crown Scroll inscribed (drift)."
        WriteLog "? Drift Detected � cloud.exe missing post-build."
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub cmdRunCloud_Click()
    Dim ctx As GFRunContext

    GF_InitRunContext ctx

    If Not GF_CanRunCloud(ctx) Then
        GFMsg "Drift Detected � cloud.exe missing."
        WriteLog "? Attempted run, but cloud.exe missing @ " & ctx.filePath
        Exit Sub
    End If

    GF_RunCloud ctx
End Sub

Private Sub cmdBuild_Click()
    lblStatus.Caption = "Building Cloud Engine..."
    WriteLog "Build button pressed."
    CloudEngine_Run "C:cloud.ppj"
End Sub








Private Sub cmdRebuildProject_Click()
    Dim clipText As String
    clipText = Clipboard.GetText()

    If InStr(clipText, "# Project Source Dump") = 0 Then
        MsgBox "Clipboard does not contain a valid project scroll.", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' Rebuild files from scroll
    SaveSection clipText, "## Batch.bas", App.path & "\Batch.bas"
    SaveSection clipText, "## Batch.cls", App.path & "\Batch.cls"
    SaveSection clipText, "## FormMain.frm", App.path & "\FormMain.frm"

    ' Auto-open first project in folder
    LoadVBProject "D:\VBGOD_LD\StarshipDetector"

    MsgBox "? Darkstar project files rebuilt and VB6 project refreshed.", vbInformation
End Sub

Private Sub cmdRun_Click()
    WriteLog "Run button pressed."
    Project_RunSelected lstProjects
End Sub

Private Sub cmdVerify_Click()
    WriteLog "Verify button pressed."
    lblStatus.Caption = "Cloud artifact: " & "output\cloud.exe"
End Sub

Private Sub cmdChecksum_Click()
    WriteLog "Checksum button pressed."
    lblStatus.Caption = "Checksum ritual pending."
End Sub

Private Sub cmdRepair_Click()
    WriteLog "Repair button pressed."
    lblStatus.Caption = "Repair headers pending."
End Sub
Private Sub cmdShellPPJ_Click()
    Dim files As New Collection
    Dim driftAlerts As New Collection
    
    ' Log button press
    WriteLog "? Button pressed: " & cmdShellPPJ.Caption
    
    ' Shell the PPJ build script
    Dim g As DarkstarGF
g = GF(App.path & "\PellesC_engine\", "build_cloud_ppj.bat", "build_log.txt")
SafeShellGF g
files.Add "cloud.ppj"
    files.Add "build_cloud_ppj.bat"
    files.Add "build_log.txt"
    
    ' Check for exe artifact
    Dim exePath As String
    
exePath = GFPath(App.path & "\PellesC_engine\output\", "cloud.exe")

If GFExists(exePath) Then
    ' cloud.exe exists � proceed

        SafeShell App.path & "\PellesC_engine\output\", "cloud.exe", "cloud_run_log.txt"
        files.Add "cloud.exe"
        files.Add "cloud_run_log.txt"
        VBGOD_LDR_FRM.lblPPJStatus.Caption = "PPJ shell run complete."
    Else
        VBGOD_LDR_FRM.lblPPJStatus.Caption = "PPJ shell run failed � exe missing."
    End If
    
    ' Collect drift alerts
    Set driftAlerts = CollectDriftAlerts()
    
    ' Write crown scroll
    WriteCrownScroll "cloud.ppj", "output\cloud.exe", files, driftAlerts
    VBGOD_LDR_FRM.lblScrollStatus.Caption = "Crown Scroll inscribed."
End Sub

Private Sub cmdCrown_Click()
    DarkstarFormOnTop Me
    lblScrollStatus.Caption = "Crown Scroll inscribed � Form OnTop."
End Sub

Private Sub cmdExportSource_Click()
    Dim f As Integer
    Dim exportPath As String

    ' Where to write the source dump
    exportPath = App.path & "\project_source.md"

    f = FreeFile
    Open exportPath For Output As #f

    ' Header
    Print #f, "# Project Source Dump"
    Print #f, "Generated: " & Format$(Now, "yyyy-mm-dd hh:nn:ss")
    Print #f, ""

    ' Dump key files (you can expand this list)
    Print #f, "## Batch.bas"
    Print #f, GetFileText(App.path & "\Batch.bas")
    Print #f, ""

    Print #f, "## Batch.cls"
    Print #f, GetFileText(App.path & "\Batch.cls")
    Print #f, ""

    Print #f, "## FormMain.frm"
    Print #f, GetFileText(App.path & "\FormMain.frm")
    Print #f, ""

    ' Add more files as needed
    ' Print #f, "## ModuleX.bas"
    ' Print #f, GetFileText(App.Path & "\ModuleX.bas")

    Close #f

    MsgBox "? Project source exported to: " & exportPath, vbInformation
End Sub


Public Sub LoadVBProject(folder As String)
    Dim f As String
    Dim projFile As String

    ' Ensure trailing backslash
    If Right$(folder, 1) <> "\" Then folder = folder & "\"

    ' Check folder exists
    If Len(Dir$(folder, vbDirectory)) = 0 Then
        MsgBox "? Project folder not found: " & folder, vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' Find first .vbp file in folder
    projFile = Dir$(folder & "*.vbp")
    If projFile = "" Then
        MsgBox "? No VB6 project file (.vbp) found in: " & folder, vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' Shell VB6 with detected project
    SafeShell "vb6.exe " & Chr$(34) & folder & projFile & Chr$(34), False, App.path & "\batch_log.txt"
End Sub




Private Sub cmdExportDarkstar_Click()

    Dim vbpPath As String
    Dim folder As String
    Dim outPath As String
    Dim lines As Collection
    Dim line As Variant
    Dim modName As String
    Dim fileName As String
    Dim filePath As String
    Dim src As String
    Dim f As Integer

    folder = "D:\darkstar\"
    vbpPath = folder & "darkstar.vbp"
    outPath = folder & "source_file.md"

    If Dir$(vbpPath) = "" Then
        MsgBox "Cannot find darkstar.vbp in D:\darkstar", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Set lines = ReadAllLines(vbpPath)

    f = FreeFile
    Open outPath For Output As #f

    Print #f, "# Darkstar Source Dump"
    Print #f, "Generated: " & Format$(Now, "yyyy-mm-dd hh:nn:ss")
    Print #f, ""

    For Each line In lines

        ' -------------------------
        '   MODULE
        ' -------------------------
        If Left$(Trim$(line), 7) = "Module=" Then
            ParseVBPModuleLine line, modName, fileName
            filePath = folder & fileName
            src = SafeReadFile(filePath)

            Print #f, "## Module: " & modName & " (" & fileName & ")"
            Print #f, src
            Print #f, ""

        ' -------------------------
        '   CLASS
        ' -------------------------
        ElseIf Left$(Trim$(line), 6) = "Class=" Then
            ParseVBPModuleLine line, modName, fileName
            filePath = folder & fileName
            src = SafeReadFile(filePath)

            Print #f, "## Class: " & modName & " (" & fileName & ")"
            Print #f, src
            Print #f, ""

        ' -------------------------
        '   FORM
        ' -------------------------
        ElseIf Left$(Trim$(line), 5) = "Form=" Then
            ParseVBPModuleLine line, modName, fileName
            filePath = folder & fileName
            src = SafeReadFile(filePath)

            Print #f, "## Form: " & modName & " (" & fileName & ")"
            Print #f, src
            Print #f, ""

        End If

    Next line

    Close #f

    MsgBox "Darkstar source exported to source_file.md", vbInformation

End Sub



Private Sub Form_Load()
    Dim base As String
    Dim pelles As String
    Dim first As Boolean
  Dim regenFlag As String

    ' Read the flag from darkstar.ini
    regenFlag = ReadINIKey("RegenRES")

    ' Mandatory regeneration if flag is set
    If regenFlag = "1" Then
        ' Default to Starship mode unless you override
        GenerateRES "Starship"
        MsgBox "BatchResources regenerated at startup (Starship mode).", vbInformation
    End If
    first = FirstRun() 'todo:resolve resourceflag of first run error handeling

    If first Then
        ' First time: write canonical base paths and clear FirstRun later if desired
        InitBasePaths
        SetFirstRunFlag False
    End If
